title: Reconnect fuel, coolant, electrical, A/C, shifter and axles

notices.text: Work from the photographs. New O-rings on every A/C joint and have the system evacuated and recharged professionally. New crush washers/O-rings on fuel fittings. Double-check both engine ground straps. Before you fill anything, do a connector audit against your teardown photos — a single unplugged sensor will have you chasing a phantom for an evening.
